description.value:
The forbidden technique Tsunade unleashes in extremis. You release the chakra stored in your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-shinobi.spells.Item.SpllMdHundredSel]{Strength of a Hundred Seal} all at once, causing your body to constantly regenerate from any wound.

Requirements You have an active Strength of a Hundred Seal.

The seal dissolves. For 1 minute, you have fast healing equal to twice your level, are immune to persistent damage, and any death-effect that would reduce you to 0 HP instead reduces you to 1 HP (once per round). Your unarmed Strikes deal 1d8 additional vitality damage to undead and creatures that are not currently regenerating.

When the duration ends, you suffer 1d4 negative levels (treat as drained 4) and cannot use this jutsu again for 1 month. If you accumulate enough negative levels to reduce your effective level below 1, you die instantly as the borrowed life force consumes you.
